عَسَلِىٌّ A thing of the colour of عَسَل [i. e. honey]. (TA.) ―
-b2- [Hence,] عَسَلِىُّ اليَهُودِ The distinctive mark, or sign, [which has sometimes been a honey-coloured turban, at other times a girdle, or some other article of attire, of the same colour,] of the Jews. (S, Mgh, O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
